1.purpose: S67 needs a Concorde: this is a T-tail business jet.
1.notes: RETAKE with an explicit Concorde description (ogival delta, no tailplane, drooped needle nose, four podded engines).

2.purpose: Supersonic-looking jet with a needle nose.
2.artefacts: Has a T-tail and podded engines: not a Concorde.

3.purpose: S67 delivered: a Concorde-type SST in clean side profile above a sea of clouds at dusk (needle nose, slender fuselage with a window row, single swept fin and no tailplane, rectangular under-wing nacelle), camera tracking alongside.
3.artefacts: Wing planform not visible in pure profile.
3.short: Wing planform not visible in pure profile.

chosen_why: The only take that reads as a Concorde (no tailplane, needle nose).
